name: E and J Electrical Contractor LLC
what_they_do: Commercial and industrial electrical contractor at 501 Adams Lane, Suite 3, North Brunswick, in business since 2007. It does electrical installations including Class I Division 1 work, maintenance contracts, new construction and motor controls, and is registered as a New Jersey state vendor (NJSTART) with a Procore trade profile - so it sells to general contractors, facilities and public buyers rather than homeowners.
customers: General contractors, industrial facilities and public-sector buyers (state vendor registration, Procore network profile, CIS trade listing)

size_signals.signal: 'In business since 2007', bonded, union and non-union capable, specialising in industrial installations
Registered New Jersey state vendor (NJSTART vendor V00022046)
Procore specialty-contractor profile in the electrical trade, North Brunswick NJ
BBB profile exists but is not accredited and not rated for lack of information

listing.platform: BBB (not rated); no Google rating found

website_review.trust_signals: none on the web; credibility lives only in Procore, NJSTART and CIS directory records
website_review.out_of_date_signs: The domain the company is listed under (eandjelectrical.com) now resolves through https to a GoDaddy 'this domain is parked free' page - the website has lapsed
website_review.search_basics: No live site, so no title, description or service pages; searches return BBB and paywalled construction directories instead
top_issues: Domain is parked - the only website the company is listed with is dead
No live site at all, so no capability statement, project list or service pages
No Google rating or reviews anywhere
Directory data conflicts (North Brunswick office vs a Rockaway address, two phone numbers)

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: address and phone appear in directories and a BBB profile, but no current website and no review profile. Answerable: nothing on the web describes services, coverage, hours or bonding in readable form. Bookable: no form and no site - bid requests come by phone/email to the owner.

operations_signals.signal: Commercial/industrial bid work means RFQ, submittal and COI document handling, all of which now depends on email/phone (inference from trade type plus NJSTART/Procore presence, not directly documented)
Public-sector vendor registration implies recurring bid submissions and compliance paperwork

top_opportunities.opportunity: Stand up a real site on the existing domain: capability statement, Class I Div 1 / motor-control services, project list, licence and bonding, bid-request form
top_opportunities.evidence: eandjelectrical.com is a parked GoDaddy page, so directories point prospects to a dead link.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Bid/RFQ intake agent that logs invitations and drafts prequalification and COI replies from a document library
top_opportunities.evidence: State-vendor registration and a Procore profile imply steady bid invitations handled manually.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Claim and complete a Google Business Profile plus listings cleanup (one address, one phone)
top_opportunities.evidence: No Google rating found; two addresses and two phone numbers circulate.

scores.reasons: Gap: dead domain and no reviews, though real commercial credibility exists off-site (4). Pay: commercial/industrial and public-sector work since 2007 (4). Ease: a capability site is a contained project (4). Evidence: CIS, Procore, NJSTART and BBB records, but no direct owner contact or site to read (3).
